bends.note: Florence runs straight NE-SW from Gilbert (centreline y = 4529 - 0.763x, from building lines measured at x 1700-2600) to here, then turns to run SSW (dx/dy ~ -0.29) to the bottom edge; the dashed water pipes bend at the same place (~1330,3500)

notes: McMillan's north half runs off the top edge (scan edge ~y 183); its centre is taken at y~252 from the water-pipe lines and the south block line. The strip west of Concord is the east edge of sheet 196 (Burbank and Wilkinson are labelled there; Burbank printed here 'BURBANK'); both end at Concord as T-junctions, while Morgan, Wayne and Lindsay Alley cross Concord. Morgan is 50 ft west of Concord but printed 35' east of it. 'COPELEN' is the printed street name (large label); correction slips spell it 'COPELAND' (as the key maps do). Copelen runs from McMillan south to Florence; Wayne and Morgan end at it from the west. The 20 ft alley one block south of McMillan is printed 'LINDSAY (KEMPER)' / 'ALLEY' and runs Concord to Finch; 'LONDON 3 (ALBION) ALLEY' (20 ft) runs Concord to Finch. Finch Alley (10 ft) is labelled 'ALLEY' at its north end and 'FINCH' further south; it runs McMillan to Florence along the back of the Copelen lots. Burgoyne Alley (10 ft, labelled 'BURGOYNE' and 'ALLEY') runs parallel to Gilbert from McMillan down to Post Alley; 'POST ALLEY' (12 ft) runs from Finch east to Gilbert. Eggleston Alley (12 ft) is labelled 'ALLEY' at its Morgan end and 'EGGLESTON' further south; it runs Morgan to Florence, meeting Florence exactly at Florence's bend. The unnamed 12 ft alley in block 4 runs from Eggleston east to Copelen behind the Morgan lots. Gilbert Avenue (printed '100'' south of Florence; '60' labels also appear inside it near McMillan and near the Florence junction, probably a roadway width) measures ~95-100 ft between building lines; it crosses McMillan (continues north into Volume 4) and takes Post Alley, Florence and Finch-side traffic from the west and two streets from the east: the street at y~1060 east of Gilbert is unlabelled here and recorded as Curtis Street (the street key map 2 prints CURTIS at the top of sheet 198), and 'ROGERS PL.' at y~3218. Gilbert's centreline north of Florence is taken midway between its east line (x = 3596 - 0.322(y-972)) and the Gilbert lot fronts on the west (x = 3147 - 0.327(y-1369)), about 85 ft apart (the printed '60' figures inside Gilbert here look like an older or roadway width; 100' is printed south of Florence and measures ~101 ft at Rogers Place). The Gilbert/Florence and Gilbert/Post Alley points are computed from those centrelines (Florence centreline y = 4529 - 0.763x; Post Alley centreline y = 1603 + 0.31(x-3060)). Eggleston Alley opens into Florence at Florence's bend, its west line continuing as Florence's west line south of the bend; the Eggleston/Florence point is where the alley axis (x~1236) meets the upper Florence centreline extended, about 100 px west of the bend vertex. Finch Alley's north end at McMillan is pinched by building overhangs (~6 ft clear); its centre there is taken in line with the alley to the south. Burgoyne Alley and Finch Alley both end at Post Alley within ~50 px of each other. Burgoyne runs NNE parallel to Gilbert (axis slope dx/dy ~-0.3); its McMillan point is its axis extended to McMillan's centreline. Concord and Florence converge at the bottom edge but their centrelines meet off the sheet, so no point is recorded. A narrow unlabelled gap between lots at y~1555 east of Copelen (opposite Post Alley) and a narrow passage at x~1420 between London Alley and Morgan are not recorded as alleys. Possible streets north of McMillan (Volume 4) cannot be seen on this sheet.
